system.notes: Turns a voluntary subject into a normal critter that keeps human consciousness. Physical attributes from the Critter Statistics Table (SR2 p.233), +1 to the base ratings per 2 successes; Reaction rises by the subject's Intelligence; mental attributes stay. Clothing and gear don't change. A magician can still cast, but not fulfil geasa or use centering that needs actions the animal can't do (speech). Grimoire (2nd ed.) p.132.
